meta.purpose: Static config for grade_print.py — turns the Q2 bank-print grading instrument into a checkable grader.
meta.note: Q1 baselines = agent-curated/primary as flagged in source; verify vs 10-Q/release before any trade. No market data here — only filing numbers.

master_rule: Provision expense $ > Net charge-off $ this quarter = BUILDING (transmission live); Provision < NCO = RELEASING (mask/defer).
disc1_rule: A build counts toward path (a) ONLY if SPECIFIC (named-credit migration / individually-evaluated reserve). COLLECTIVE / macro-overlay (CECL Q-factors, GDP/unemployment, asset-growth) = BETA, non-counting.
disc2_rule: AOCI/NIM/TBV is a SEPARATE axis (path b). A name can print clean NCO and still transmit via rates. Grade independently.
disc3_rule: MONOLINE UN-MASK (path m): monolines composition-mask — book-shrinkage/survivor-pool suppresses headline NCO. Grade the un-maskable sub-signals, NOT headline NCO: a BUILD on a FLAT/SHRINKING book is unambiguous deterioration (cannot be growth-beta); a RAISED NCO guide or RISING early-DQ formation are masking-proof tells.

b.fires: non-credit AOCI/NIM/TBV selloff regardless of NCO

m.fires: un-masked consumer-credit deterioration across >=2 monolines (synchronized), OR 1 monoline with >=2 un-mask tells
m.base_odds: monoline LEAD block, earliest Q2 tell ~Jul 18-23

decision_rules: 1. Default (monoline beat + releases/collective-only builds): Q2 exception does NOT fire -> roll bank duration to Q1-Q2 2027, no fresh Q2 short.
2. Path (b) fires (>=2 AOCI/NIM/TBV selloffs): rates-driven exception live; most likely Q2 surprise; size ~25-30%. Watch ZION (don't mis-grade green NCO).
3. Path (a) fires (>=2 SPECIFIC builds): genuine synchronized credit transmission early -> escalate; confirm specific not collective.
4. Path (c) fires (WAL full charge-off): single-name bear-confirm.
5. COF both-segments build = strongest single signal (synchronized consumer+CRE on one balance sheet).
6. Beta guard: collective/macro-overlay builds across the board = higher-for-longer regime repricing (beta tell) -> note it, NOT a fresh-short trigger.

7. Monoline path (m) fires (un-masked consumer deterioration): the EARLIEST leading tell -> escalate the consumer leg; monoline fire card TRY-FIRE-003 is live. A monoline BREAK also raises regional build odds (gate); a BEAT fades path (a).

gate.name: monoline gate (Jul 21)
gate.beat: monoline BEAT Jul 21 -> no macro forcing function -> fade path (a) before EGBN/WAL print.
gate.break: monoline BREAK Jul 21 (NCO up + coverage falling, ABS-curve corroborated) -> EGBN/WAL build odds rise.

SYF.build_if: Prov > NCO; coverage >=10.42% holds/rises vs flat-down NCO (costly confession); RSA payments falling
SYF.release_if: Prov < NCO; coverage <=~10.1% (-30bps+); guide reaffirmed to flatter EPS
SYF.q1_posture: BUILT +36bps->10.42% vs improving NCO -> leans transmission-live

ALLY.build_if: SPECIFIC-cohort build (named auto/used-vehicle migration): Prov > NCO with retail-auto NCO >=+30bps QoQ
ALLY.release_if: build stays growth/collective, or ACL$ down; retail-auto NCO flat-down
ALLY.q1_posture: Q1'26 = +$50M CECL BUILD (Prov 467 > NCO ~417) but GROWTH-DRIVEN = COLLECTIVE -> NON-COUNTING (Disc-1). NOT a $224M release.

COF.build_if: card-seg provision > card NCO; Card NCO >=+25bps QoQ
COF.release_if: ACL drawn down; Discover conforming marks used to offset
COF.q1_posture: BUILT $230M total but Card RELEASED $8M, Auto +$155M, Commercial +$83M -> card releasing / auto+CRE building
COF.bridge: Card=Axis-A consumer, Commercial=Axis-B CRE on one balance sheet. Both build = SYNCHRONIZED (decision rule 5).

CFG.build_if: Prov > NCO AND ACL/loans up QoQ AND criticized/NPL rising — reverses 5-qtr NCO decline; esp CRE or BDC fund-fin (specific)
CFG.q1_posture: blind first read (no gate). housing-secured 38.2% of loans.

OZK.build_if: past-due climbs off Q1 1.48% AND NCO >0.56% toward 50bps guide AND specific RESG reserves (IQHQ pre-position)
OZK.release_if: past-due reverts (lumpy), NCO <=0.56%, no RESG migration
OZK.q1_posture: RESG 88% UNVERIFIED (not a Call-Report line). OZK files NO 10-Q (FDIC Call Report). IQHQ Aug maturity is AFTER this print.

ZION.build_if: NCO turns UP off 0.03% trough AND release STOPS (provision positive) = Hyp-A heal falsified
ZION.q1_posture: designated credit bull-control. path-b is the FALSE-CONTROL TRAP + highest mis-grade risk.

EGBN.build_if: coverage of nonaccruals keeps falling off 114% OR catch-up provision (Prov >> NCO) rebuilds toward 149% AND IPRE/office nonaccrual rises (specific)
EGBN.release_if: coverage rebuilds via NPA cure (not provision); NPA reverts toward 1.04%; no new office migration
EGBN.q1_posture: cleanest path-(a) candidate; single most likely. Gated by monoline Jul 21. CRE 295.1%/construction 75.7% now BELOW reg thresholds.

WAL.axis: c full charge-off + a build-defer + b AOCI
WAL.build_if: (c) ex-fraud NCO >55bps AND majority (>$50M) of the $99M life-sci credit charged off in-Q2
WAL.release_if: NCO <40bps, $99M cures/sponsor returns, classified continues -9bp trend, H2-decline guide affirmed
WAL.build_defer_if: NCO 40-45bps AND $99M kept nonaccrual with larger specific reserve AND classified rises (office classified >$500M) = partial (counts toward a, not c)
WAL.q1_posture: 39bps = NON-GAAP ADJUSTED; GAAP/reported = 1.45%. $99M = OUTSTANDING BALANCE of a CRE non-owner-occ loan (life-science collateral), late-Apr subsequent event, appraisal pending — NOT a Q1 realized loss.

basis_required.guard: ERROR unless --basis provided AND == 'adjusted'. Q1 39bps baseline is NON-GAAP ADJUSTED; comparing a GAAP Q2 NCO (~1.45% basis) misfires on a unit mismatch.
basis_required.fix: Provide WAL Q2 ex-fraud ADJUSTED NCO and run with --basis adjusted.

total_afs_required.guard: ERROR unless --aoci-basis == 'total-afs' when grading path-b. muni-AFS ~$869M FV is NOT the mechanism (the $5.78B is TOTAL muni incl HTM/loans that DON'T flow to AOCI). Re-anchor on TOTAL AFS securities AOCI.
total_afs_required.fix: Use ZION's TOTAL AFS securities AOCI move (6/30 mark) with --aoci-basis total-afs.

build_type_required.applies_to: ALLY (and any path-a member showing a build)
build_type_required.guard: A build needs --build-type specific|collective. COLLECTIVE/growth-driven build = BETA -> NON-COUNTING for path (a) even though Prov>NCO. ALLY Q1 +$50M was collective.
build_type_required.fix: Classify from the roll-forward language: named-cohort migration = specific; 'economic outlook/scenario/asset-growth' = collective.

discover_conforming_flag.guard: WARN — Discover conforming one-time ACL (~100% platform by Q3'26) can inflate the apparent build. Flag one-time-conforming vs run-rate before scoring.
discover_conforming_flag.fix: Separate one-time conforming ACL from run-rate provision.

no_10q_research_grade.guard: WARN — OZK files no 10-Q (FDIC Call Report). RESG 88% is UNVERIFIED. Treat as research-grade.
no_10q_research_grade.fix: Source OZK from 10-K/investor deck for RESG; Call Report for past-due/NCO.
